blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 154 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 19, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DRX & CDW lead 154 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 54 Canadian and 100 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 19, 2026) found 154 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 54 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 34 of them new to the list this week. ADF Group Inc. (DRX) leads with a +104% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 12 names.

In the U.S., 100 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 61 of them new to the list this week. CDW Corporation (CDW) leads with a +56% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 28 names.
